# Support

Thank you for using the Vue.js Masterclass project! This document provides information on how to get help.

## Documentation

Before seeking support, please check:

- **[README.md](../README.md)** - Project overview, setup instructions, and features
- **[Contributing Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md)** - Development workflow and coding standards
- **Code Comments** - Many components include inline documentation

## Getting Help

### For Learning Questions

If you have questions about Vue.js concepts demonstrated in this project:

1. Check the official documentation:

   - [Vue 3 Documentation](https://vuejs.org/)
   - [Pinia Documentation](https://pinia.vuejs.org/)
   - [Vue Router Documentation](https://router.vuejs.org/)
   - [Vitest Documentation](https://vitest.dev/)
   - [TailwindCSS Documentation](https://tailwindcss.com/)

2. Review the course materials from [Boris Paskhaver's Udemy course](https://www.udemy.com/user/borispaskhaver/)

### For Technical Issues

If you encounter bugs or technical problems:

1. **Search existing issues**: Check if someone has already reported the same problem
2. **Create a new issue**: If not found, [open a new issue](../../issues/new) with:
   - Clear description of the problem
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Expected vs actual behavior
   - Environment details (OS, Node version, etc.)
   - Error messages or screenshots

### For Feature Requests

To suggest new features or improvements:

1. Check existing issues and discussions
2. Open a new issue with the label "enhancement"
3. Describe the feature and its benefits
4. Provide use cases or examples

## Common Issues

### Installation Problems

```bash
# Clear cache and reinstall
rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
npm install
```

### Type Errors

```bash
# Run type checking
npm run type-check
```

### Test Failures

```bash
# Run tests with coverage
npm run test:coverage
```

### Build Issues

```bash
# Clean build
rm -rf dist
npm run build
```

## Community

While this is primarily an educational project, you can:

- Star the repository if you find it helpful
- Fork it to create your own version
- Share your learning experience
- Contribute improvements via pull requests

## Response Times

As this is an educational project maintained by learners:

- Issues will be addressed as time permits
- Pull requests are welcome and will be reviewed
- No guaranteed SLA for responses
